case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

reviewQuestions: Are materials grounded and quantities sufficient?
Are steps complete and captions faithful?
Does the final result follow from shown operations?

design.purpose: A weathered pine planter for herbs or flowers on a patio, with 20 cm soil depth and drainage holes in the base.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting
Cut front, back, ends and offcut to length
Place the base board flat for cutting
Cut the base and keep the offcut aside
Place the base flat on the floor
Drill three drainage holes through the base
Stand the front side on the base front edge
Stand the back side on the base back edge
Fit the left end between the front and back
Fit the right end between the front and back
Screw the front to the left end (2 screws)
Screw the front to the right end (2 screws)
Screw the back to the left end (2 screws)
Screw the back to the right end (2 screws)
Screw up through the base into the front (2 screws)
Screw up through the base into the back (2 screws)
Screw up through the base into the left end (1 screws)
Screw up through the base into the right end (1 screws)
Sand the top edges smooth all round
